reviews.rationale: Spelling alias review: 伍 added to 五/ご. Nihongo Master row 伍/ご 'five (used in legal documents)'. JMdict 1268060 五/５/伍【ご】 lists 伍 as a spelling of 五 'five' in the same entry (the daiji form used on cheques/legal documents). The card vocab-n5:1470 五/ご 'fünf' has the identical reading and sense, so 伍 is added as alias. (The other 伍 entry 2842952 'company; rank' is a different sense not meant by this gloss.) Notes, examples, meaning and pitch of the accepted card are unchanged and were reread against the alias.
